title: ytickformat
summary: Query or set the Y-axis tick label format for the current axes, a specified axes handle, or an axes array.
description: `ytickformat` controls automatic Y-axis tick label formatting. It supports query, numeric format assignment, MATLAB shorthand formats such as `usd` and `percentage`, custom printf-style numeric formats, date/duration format strings for compatibility, scalar axes query forms, and axes-array setter forms.

arguments.name: fmt
arguments.description: Tick label format. `auto` maps to `%g`; shorthands include `usd`, `eur`, `gbp`, `jpy`, `degrees`, and `percentage`; custom numeric formats use printf-style conversions such as `%.2f` or `$%,.0f`.

arguments.name: ax
arguments.description: Target axes handle or axes handle array. Query forms require a scalar axes handle; setter forms apply to every axes in the array. If omitted, the current axes are used.

examples.description: Show Y-axis tick labels as percentages
Apply a format to a specific subplot
examples.output: % Only ax2 receives the dollar tick-label format

notes: `ytickformat` shares state with the Y-axis ruler `TickLabelFormat` property, so `set(get(gca, 'YAxis'), 'TickLabelFormat', fmt)` and `ytickformat(fmt)` are equivalent for the current axes.
Explicit `yticklabels` values take precedence over automatic formatting until tick label mode is returned to automatic.

Date and duration format strings are stored and returned for compatibility. Current RunMat plotting axes are numeric, so nonnumeric date/duration rendering falls back to numeric label formatting until datetime/duration axes are introduced.
gpu_residency: `ytickformat` only reads and writes axes metadata. It does not inspect, gather, or transform GPU-resident plot data; formatted labels are generated from tick metadata at render/query time.
